hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: To make index i strictly greater than neighbors, it must be at least max(nums[i - 1], nums[i + 1]) + 1.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Calculate the cost to make index i a peak as max(0, max(nums[i - 1], nums[i + 1]) + 1 - nums[i]).

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sum these costs over the target alternating indices to find the minimum increase.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass checks neighbor peaks and accumulates required increases.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating incremental increments step by step is too slow.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Computes exact target ceiling max(left, right) + 1 directly.
